### The Role of Fasting
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/role-fasting
Passage: Ezra 8:21-23
Points:
- Traveling without an armed military escort left Ezra and the returning exiles completely vulnerable to thieves and enemies.
- Fasting placed the people in a state of physical weakness to emphasize their deep need for divine grace.
- Fasting serves to remind believers of their creaturely helplessness and dependence on their Creator.
- Fasting does not obligate God to grant requests, but glorifies Him by showing genuine reliance upon Him.
- God responds with blessing and reveals Himself to those who seek Him with sincere humility.

### A Call to Fast for Humility and Power
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/a-call-to-fast-for-humility-and-power
Passage: Ezra 8:21
Points:
- Ezra chose to fast and seek divine protection rather than asking the Persian king for soldiers.
- Fasting serves as an intentional biblical means for believers to humble themselves before the Lord.
- Abstaining from food acknowledges our unworthiness and our desperate need for God's mercy.
- Foregoing physical nourishment demonstrates that our desire for Christ is greater than our craving for food.
- God hears the pleas of His people when they turn from self-reliance and cry out for spiritual power.
